subject: Post-call: CMK/HSM options, logging & retention — next steps
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@paygen.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Post-call recap — CMK/HSM options, logging & retention (PayGen)

Hi Alice — thanks for the time today. Quick recap from the discovery and the items we agreed to follow up on: 

1) High-level encryption needs you mentioned
   - In-transit: TLS 1.3 required between clients and our ingress.
   - At-rest: AES-256 encryption for models and token storage.
   - Key ownership: preference for customer-managed keys (BYOK) with HSM-backed keys (CloudHSM/AWS KMS HSM).
   - Key usage controls: separation of duties and audit for any key unwrap operations; policy-based access (roles, MFA for ops).

2) Logging & retention
   - Audit logs for key operations and request trace must be retained for at least 5 years (you indicated 5–7 years may be required by compliance).
   - Need to surface per-request metadata (request id, model id, route) in logs for incident forensics — redaction options required.

3) Evidence & artifacts you requested
   - KMS/HSM architecture options doc (attached): hosted BYOK, dedicated pool + wrap keys, and private (on-prem) HSM patterns.
   - Sample audit log schema and retention playbook (we can tailor to PayGen’s retention policy).

4) Open questions for you
   - Which cloud provider(s) will host your keys (AWS KMS vs GCP KMS vs Azure Key Vault)?
   - Will you require on-prem HSM for primary key material, or is a cloud HSM acceptable as long as it is customer-controlled?
   - Do you have a target timeline for procurement / pilot?

Next steps we propose:
   A) We’ll share the CMK/HSM options doc (attached) and a short comparison matrix by EOD Monday.
   B) Schedule a 30–45 minute follow-up call next week with our Security TP lead (Stephanie) to walk the audit schema and BYOK flow.
   C) If PayGen prefers hosted BYOK, we’ll produce a draft mutual action plan with milestones and an initial cost estimate for the BYOK workflow.

Attachments: redwood-cmk-options-onepager.pdf (overview)

If that summary looks right, I’ll loop in Stephanie and propose times.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@paygen.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 17:10:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — CMK/HSM options, logging & retention (PayGen)

Marcus, thanks — that looks good. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We prefer AWS KMS with HSM-backed keys (CloudHSM / KMS multi-tenant HSM) for now.
- Primary requirement: cryptographic operations (decrypt/unseal) must require a role-based approval and be logged with user id + justification (we have an internal process that expects this).
- Retention: 7 years for key operation logs; 1 year for request-level telemetry, unless flagged for investigation.
- Timeline: we’re aiming for a limited production pilot in Q3 (target late Aug). Procurement will need a cost estimate and an ops runbook.

I attached our security questionnaire and highlighted sections related to key ownership and logging. Can your team populate the KMS integration section before the follow-up call?

—Alice
Alice Monroe
Head of Product Security | PayGen Financial
alice.monroe@paygen.com

> Attachment: paygen-security-questionnaire.xlsx
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@paygen.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 13:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — CMK/HSM options, logging & retention (PayGen)

Hi Alice — looping Stephanie from our Security team for the BYOK / audit-schema work. Quick answers and a proposed plan: 

Short answers
- AWS KMS (HSM-backed) is fully supported in our hosted BYOK pattern — customer supplies/master-creates CMK, we integrate via KMS grants and do not store plaintext key material.
- Role-based policy + MFA for key usage: we can require a two-person approval for key unwrapping in the Dedicated and Private deployment patterns; for hosted BYOK we enforce access via KMS grants + Redwood RBAC and can integrate with your IdP for break-glass flows.
- Audit logs: we can forward a copy of key-operation logs + request metadata to your SIEM (Syslog/HTTPS) and retain a primary copy per your retention settings.

Proposed next steps (owners & timeline)
1) Stephanie: prepare a 30–40 min run-through of the audit log schema + BYOK flow (deliverable: Confluence page + sample logs) — ETA Wed 05/05.
2) Marcus: produce a short cost delta estimate for hosted BYOK vs Dedicated (deliverable: spreadsheet) — ETA Tue 05/04.
3) PayGen: confirm desired cloud KMS provider (Alice) and share any procurement constraints — ETA Tue 05/04.

Action items table (for clarity)
- Stephanie Nguyen — Audit schema + sample logs (05/05)
- Marcus Lin — Pricing delta & pilot milestone draft (05/04)
- Alice Monroe — Confirm KMS provider & review questionnaire (05/04)

Would Wed 05/06 10:00am PT work for the run-through with Stephanie? If yes we’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
